name: s81lk_kp4_dec-ec1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder leaf (one per SerDes link macro), never kitted before (census 10-16). Bench = H-DIE KP4_GATE configuration base (119/137 frames exact, 17 beyond-t flagged, 0 miscorrected vs rs544.py) and its decoder mutant DMUT2 (Forney).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_dec u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_dec.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dec/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dec/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dec --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_dec  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW leaf (ELEM-CENSUS 10-16, census class F, S-DIE ok 12:20): KP4 RS(544,514) FEC decoder (AM align, syndromes, 4 BM units, Chien/Forney, uncorrectable flag) of the S81 board/cable link, real on-die digital sublayer inside the ot_pdie_serdes blackbox (die_contracts.json leaf row, parent ot_pdie_serdes); clocked by the recovered clock pma_rck (tile port clk). RTL = H-DIE structural rewrite (main 7a8b12424). Outline sized from the H-DIE SerDes SYNTH (dec ~110k um2 std incl. cmul/vmul/inv cells) + pin registers at ~62% util, aspect 1.5 (W/E data faces on the long side). S-DIE serdes/ucie macro boundary (physical/asap7_v41x_pdie_macros_v2/ot_pdie_serdes.lef, 250.056 x 2250.216 W/E link column, R0 = west column): PMA lanes / pads on the W (die-edge) face, the core-side beat bus on the E face (east column = MY mirror). p_v/p_d/clk/rst_n on W (from the PMA RX / CDR), every q_*/lock/counter output on E (to the rate matcher). NOTE S-DIE: 345.6 um wide > the 250.056 v2 macro placeholder width; the serdes column must widen (or dec sits beside the column).
